title: Nine thousand open flow mappings followed by three hundred thousand lines of keys
notes: The input is never closed, so it is an error: a syntax error at the end of the input, or a limit error if the reader refuses the nesting first. No result is allowed. Work per line must not grow with the number of open collections: a reader that looks at every open flow mapping for each line does about 2.7 billion steps here. The time bound is the robustness requirement of the kit, not a rule of the specification. Input: nine thousand `{`, then `a,` and a line break three hundred thousand times.

provenance.reference: A reader whose time was quadratic here: each line was checked against the pending implicit-key slot of every open flow mapping, taking nine seconds for a five megabyte input of this shape.
